verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.lancedb.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated index linking to markdown versions of doc pages. Every doc page is served as .md, and LanceDB also publishes agent-oriented guides: building a pipeline with an AI coding agent via a plugin, and agent branch experiments. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and independent hands-on reports of agents successfully consuming these docs.
